import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix duplicates
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix label variants in species
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix label variants in island (strip whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix label variants in sex (convert to lowercase and strip)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.lower().str.strip()
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    # Fix out of range body_mass_g (3700000 is way too high, likely typo; cap at max allowed 6500)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = 6500
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df_clean = clean(df)
    counts = df_clean['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
